newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: Ethiopian birr weakens further against the dollar.
newsitem.headline: Ethiopian birr weakens further against the dollar.

text.p: The Ethiopian birr weakened further against the dollar on Monday, the central National Bank of Ethiopia (NBE) said.
It quoted the birr at a mean rate of 6.8020 against the dollar compared to 6.7520 last week.
The bank said following a currency auction on June 14, the applicable rate for all transactions outside the auction in the June 16 to June 22 period would be birr 6.8020 to the dollar.

It said the highest bid rate at the foreign exchange auction on Saturday was 7.159 birr to the dollar whereas the lowest bid rate was 6.655. Bidders who offered rates of 6.802 and above per dollar won the full amount they tendered for, the bank added.
The total amount of foreign exchange made available at the auction was $18 million, the bank said.
The bank posted the birr at a mean rate of 11.1076 against the pound from 11.0293 on Friday, while against the yen the birr traded at 0.059588 from 0.059150 on Friday.
